card.fact_statement: An additional 150 buses were deployed to compensate for the stoppage of the Santiago Metro during the 2025 Chile blackout.
card.source_span: An additional 150 buses were deployed to compensate for the stoppage of the Santiago Metro.

target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'deployed' as 'kilichotumwa' (what was sent/deployed) and 'compensate' as 'kufidia'.
